description: Café terraces (plan 2026-11-16, increment 2): tables with a chair on each side, then a menu board and a planter, set by overgrow before the door of each shop detail records in a listed category, when a street mood asks for them (config/street_moods.json "terraces"). Only on a pedestrian street or a plaza, along the shop's wall and the facades in line with it, at most along_m from the door, and only where a passage of passage_m stays free to the building across. Pieces are rows of the allow-listed CC0 interior catalogues, first that is installed wins.
